The '''Vosadii Techno-Palace''' was a palace situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]] that served as the operational headquarters of the [[Vosadii]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. [[Selross]], the leader of the Vosadii clan, resided in the palace and rarely left the building.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
